svg.text: Insertion: design-time, RTL source. Diff crypto_core_clean.v vs crypto_core_trojan.v = the whole change.
Trigger: digital, input-controlled, SEQUENTIAL — rare ordered 3-word sequence 13375EED → C0DEFACE →
Any wrong completed transaction resets progress; a word = SEQ0 restarts it; RST_N dis-arms.
Payload: functional corruption, INTEGRITY — invert output bit 0 of exactly ONE result.
Channel: the EXISTING SPI output — no added ports. Added state: 32-bit input capture + 2-bit counter.
